card.name: Just before body surface area units
card.fires_on: The spot right before an area unit (m 2, square meter) in body-surface-area dosing. It marks mg, an opening parenthesis, or per after a BSA heading or dose.

modes.label: Dose unit before per area
modes.description: The mg or per that comes just before /m 2 or per square meter in a surface-area dose.

modes.label: Parenthesis after BSA heading
modes.description: The opening parenthesis after Body Surface Area or BSA in a dosing table header, right before m 2.

card.writes: It suppresses the word area and its variants, so the next word is not predicted to be area.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to give a body surface area unit such as m 2 in a dosing table or sentence.
